label: Causal capacity versus actual exercise and underived source
term: causal capacity versus actual exercise and underived source
resolution: CAUSAL_CAPACITY_VERSUS_ACTUAL_EXERCISE_1 is capacity, retained as an explicit primitive interpretation of supplied parameters; its common named Lean declaration remains open. CAUSAL_CAPACITY_VERSUS_ACTUAL_EXERCISE_2 is the actual transmission field of #319, with endpoint existence and causation required separately by Coherent. Boundary requires an actual source-to-effect edge, lack of intrinsic power at the effect and finite grounding. CAUSAL_CAPACITY_VERSUS_ACTUAL_EXERCISE_3 adds existence, intrinsic source status and no incoming transmission in the selected channel; it does not exclude enabling conditions or existential support. CAUSAL_CAPACITY_VERSUS_ACTUAL_EXERCISE_4 is inductively finite power grounding, not a definition of every causal dependence. CAUSAL_CAPACITY_VERSUS_ACTUAL_EXERCISE_5 is PureAct, absence of potency in the supplied respects, not present transmission. #741 reuses DEF-BORROWED-POWER-PROFILE: cap records capacity, occurs records event occurrence, and exercised records group exercise at the actual scenario. Retained is not underived; SelfExercising excludes a lender in those records, not every cause. The event and bearer domains, and the group predicate and binary transmission relation, are not interchangeable. These are overlapping distinctions, not a five-way exhaustive or exclusive classification. The exact consumer audit and remaining interpretation maps are in docs/power-existence-scope-boundary.md.
